top_categories.workout_context: When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Gran Fondo Kazakhstan's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Gran Fondo Kazakhstan's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
At Gran Fondo Kazakhstan, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.

Road-specific control matters at Gran Fondo Kazakhstan. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 59 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gran Fondo Kazakhstan. Train it until it feels boring.
59 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Base fitness for Gran Fondo Kazakhstan. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Torque for headwinds and mixed terrain. When cadence drops below 70rpm, muscular strength keeps the watts up.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.weather: August in Almaty, Kazakhstan. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Gran Fondo Kazakhstan. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Gran Fondo Kazakhstan's 59 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.
race_overlay.altitude: Gran Fondo Kazakhstan includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 59 miles of mixed terrain in Almaty, Kazakhstan.
